summary: iHuman Inc., a NYSE-listed Chinese education technology company, furnished a Form 6-K containing its press release for unaudited second-quarter 2026 results. Revenue fell to RMB173.4 million (US$25.6 million) from RMB210.9 million year over year, with a gross profit of RMB111.2 million, an operating loss of RMB20.8 million and a net loss of RMB17.5 million, versus prior-year operating income and net income. Monthly active users declined to 20.72 million. The filing notes 2025 results were retrospectively adjusted for the June 2026 All Knowledge common-control acquisition; Perfect Lingo assets were also acquired. No special-situation event, board recommendation, or deal terms were disclosed.
